description: A continuous prediction market with a live limit order book. Traders quote, take liquidity, and hold positions that settle at resolution. Profit and loss is computed from actual fills.

position.description: Net contracts held; negative is short

attrs.question: Will BTC close above $100K by resolution?
attrs.resolution: binary, pays 1.00 to the winning side

actions.description: Place a limit order. Crosses the spread to fill immediately, or rests as liquidity. Buying costs cash; you cannot bid more than you hold.
Cancel all of your resting orders in the market.
Publish your read on the market so other traders can see it. Costs nothing but moves no price by itself.
Take no action this round and wait for better conditions.

events.name: RESOLUTION_COLLAPSE
events.description: Breaking news invalidates the contract. The market gaps from near certainty to near zero within seconds.

metrics.name: pnl_by_archetype
metrics.description: Total and average realized profit and loss per trader archetype, computed from actual fills.

metrics.name: top_traders
metrics.label: name
metrics.description: Individual traders ranked by realized profit and loss.

metrics.name: cash_by_archetype
metrics.description: Final cash held, grouped by archetype.

metrics.name: action_mix
metrics.description: How often each action was taken.

metrics.name: rejection_analysis
metrics.description: Which actions were rejected by market constraints, and why.

metrics.name: activity_per_round
metrics.description: Actions per round, showing when trading intensified.
